title: Been Dope releases a new single titled "Percocet"
htmlContent:
American Based artist Been Dope is a multi-talented rapper and songwriter who is set to take over the industry by storm for years to come. Been Dope has his listeners engulfed in the musical world he created with his no-frills approach in his recent track "Percocet."

Been Dope on his recent track, "Percocet," is a smash of a production that shows that there is still plenty of creativity and innovation that can come in the form of audio to keep the audience entertained. Been Dope encompasses his listeners with his ever-green sound.
